notes.manifest: Rebuilt twice on 2026-09-30: research/feed/watch.py checkpoint from the feed clone's git objects reproduced checkpoints/2026-09-29.json byte for byte, and an independent walk of the extracted tree (git archive, case-sensitive directory) gave the same digest over 171308 files.
notes.ots: Not verified against Bitcoin: no node was available, and ots-client 0.7 does not start on Windows. The proof was parsed with the opentimestamps library: it commits to the SHA-256 of the checkpoint file and carries a Bitcoin block header attestation at height 969122, Merkle root 4d5546f12e4e4f163b486bd532437d8cc5565af464ad04cc9eab710573cca38a. That root has not been compared with the block.
notes.sigstore: Bundle present; cosign was not available, so it was not checked.
notes.extraction: The commit holds paths that differ only in case (state/remote__io.github.Zuga-luga__Zugabot.json and ...__zugabot.json). On a case-insensitive filesystem one of each pair is lost, so the snapshot tree must be extracted into a case-sensitive directory.
